title: Engine RPM Signal Switchover Malfunction
problem: Malfunction in the circuit responsible for switching or processing the engine RPM signal.
symptoms: Engine stalling; Incorrect RPM reading; Starting issues
actions: Check RPM sensor wiring; Inspect ECU connectors; Verify signal with oscilloscope
location: Near the flywheel or alternator cover.

title: Reserve Indicator Signal Too Low
problem: The fuel reserve indicator signal voltage is below the normal range.
symptoms: Fuel light stays on; Incorrect fuel level display
actions: Check fuel sensor connector; Test sensor resistance; Inspect wiring harness

title: MIL Short-circuit to Ground
problem: The Malfunction Indicator Lamp (MIL) circuit is shorted to ground.
symptoms: Check engine light stays on constantly; Dim light
actions: Inspect MIL wiring for shorts; Check ECU output pins; Verify bulb/LED condition

title: Throttle Position Sensor Signal Low
problem: The voltage signal from Throttle Position Sensor 'A' is lower than the expected range.
symptoms: Poor acceleration; Stalling at idle; Jerking while riding
actions: Check TPS connector; Verify 5V reference; Adjust or replace TPS

title: Inclination Sensor Switchover Malfunction
problem: Error in the inclination (tilt) sensor circuit.
symptoms: Engine cuts out unexpectedly; Won't start if tilted
actions: Check sensor mounting; Inspect connector for corrosion; Test tilt sensor voltage
location: Under the seat or near the battery.

title: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit Low
problem: The ECU detected low voltage or a short to ground in the injector circuit for cylinder 1.
symptoms: Engine misfire; Loss of power; Strong fuel smell
actions: Check injector wiring harness; Test injector resistance; Clean injector nozzle

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor Circuit
problem: The ECU is not receiving a valid signal from the crankshaft position sensor.
actions: Check sensor gap; Inspect sensor wiring; Replace CKP sensor
location: Near the crankshaft pulley or stator.

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor Malfunction
problem: The speed sensor signal is missing or erratic.
symptoms: Speedometer not working; Erratic speed reading
actions: Check sensor at wheel or gearbox; Clean sensor tip; Inspect wiring
location: Rear wheel or front sprocket area.
